SW2 sits 1.800mm from the board edge; JLCPCB assembly asks for 2.5mm of component-body clearance (conveyor rails and depanel routing pass through that strip)
SW3 sits 1.800mm from the board edge; JLCPCB assembly asks for 2.5mm of component-body clearance (conveyor rails and depanel routing pass through that strip)
J1's keep-out extends 1.151mm past the board outline — intended for an edge-mounted part, confirm it on JLCPCB's placement preview
U3 sits exactly on the 0.4mm pitch floor — legal, with no margin for a footprint revision

56 part(s) are in package families whose zero-rotation convention differs between EDA output and JLCPCB's library: D1, D10, D11, D12, D13, D14, D15, D16, D17, D18, D19, D2, D20, D21, D22, D23, D24, D25, D26, D27 (+36 more). Check pin-1 on each in the placement preview before paying — that screen is the only place this is catchable
USB_DP routes 50.91mm and USB_DM 40.28mm — 10.63mm of intra-pair skew against a 3.8mm budget (USB 2.0, ~150ps on FR-4). Length-match the pair or shorten the longer leg

every routed segment on this board is 0.2mm — the same copper for GND, V3_3, V5 as for a button signal. No net class distinguishes power from signal, so each rail carries whatever the router's default happens to be (745mA at 10degC by IPC-2221B)
U3's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin ADC_AVDD is 9.6mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (7 pin(s) are further)
U4's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin VCC is 9.1mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (1 pin(s) are further)
U2's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin VIN is 9.7mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (1 pin(s) are further)
2 signal(s) leave the board through J1 with no ESD clamp on them (J1.A5, J1.B5). A finger on a connector is several kilovolts
1 rail(s) have nowhere to put a probe (V3_3). Add a test point — nobody can diagnose a dead board over chat without one
U2 dissipates 0.23W at 134mA and sits about 59 degC junction, 66 degC inside the limit
